ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey), with low-intensity pixels concentrated at the trailing edges, central peduncle transition, and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral high-intensity expanses; low-intensity vertical band bisecting the center; low-intensity perimeter margin along the entire trailing edge; distinct low-intensity focal spots located in the lower-central region of the right lobe and upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; notch depth is approximately 20% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) variations from the notch to the mid-lobe; transition to lower-frequency, higher-amplitude jaggedness at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a primary convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly rounded points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of three roughly circular dark pixel groupings arranged in a triangular pattern on the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe; scattered dark circular points at both lateral extremities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast dark linear streaks visible; two primary diagonal marks on the upper-inner left lobe and several horizontal/oblique marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized area of subcutaneous discoloration (pink/tan hue) visible on the inner-left lobe near the central axis; significant dark pigmentation splotching on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique three-dot 'paw-print' pigmentation cluster on the right lobe surface; high-density dark speckling across the high-intensity regions of the proximal fluke base.
